camera.degeneracy_note: Apparent facial scale fixes only the RATIO of focal length to distance, not either alone: 35mm/0.91m, 50mm/1.30m and 85mm/2.20m all reproduce the measured 129.7 px IPD. 50mm was chosen because it maximises panorama detail: at 39.6 deg hFOV a 16K equirect shows 1802 px across frame, 94% of the plate real 1920 px, where 85mm would show only 57%. This is a defensible working assumption, not a measurement. Resolve it properly by recording the lens on set.
camera.derivation: Z = fx*IPD/ipd_px, fx = 1920*50/36 = 2666.7 px, IPD prior 63 mm, measured ipd_px 129.7
camera.ipd_source: adult prior 63 mm (SD 3.5 mm, ~5.5% 1-sigma distance error). Measure the performer with a ruler to remove this.
